studies.title: The dog
studies.caption: Dogs travelled with people into many different environments. Their history began long before farming, although the earliest stages of domestication remain debated.
studies.prompt: Natural full-body study of a medium-sized early domestic dog with plain tawny-grey coat, moderate muzzle and upright ears, resting alert beside a simple unoccupied hide shelter at temperate Eurasian woodland edge. No specific modern pedigree breed, collars or chained wolf, natural paws and curled resting tail.
